examples.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.

她可以和我们住在一起。

The house was completed five months ago.

grammar.title: 过去将来时 (Future in the Past)
grammar.structure: 主语 + would + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示从过去的角度来看将要发生的动作或状态，常用于宾语从句中。 当主句用过去时，从句要表示将来意义时使用。常用在said, told, thought等动词后的宾语从句中。

examples.en: She said that she would come to England next year.
In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
examples.zh: 在信中，她说第二年她会来英国。

grammar.title: must be 推测用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + must be + 名词/形容词
grammar.definition: 表示根据逻辑推理得出的必然结论，意为'一定是'、'肯定是' 用于对当前情况有把握的推测，语气比might be、could be更强

examples.en: It must be the only modern house in the district.
examples.zh: 它一定是这个地区唯一的现代房子。

examples.en: She must be at home now.

grammar.title: if 条件句（真实条件句）
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.definition: if引导的条件句，表示真实的或可能发生的情况 用于谈论真实的、可能发生的条件与结果

examples.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
examples.zh: 如果她来，她会得到一个惊喜。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家里。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had a letter from + 某人

original.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
original.zh: 昨天我收到了姐姐的来信。

imitations.en: I had a letter from my friend last week.
imitations.zh: 上周我收到了朋友的来信。

imitations.en: She had a letter from her mother this morning.
imitations.zh: 今天早上她收到了妈妈的来信。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + would come to + 地点 + 时间

original.en: She would come to England next year.

imitations.en: He would come to China next month.
They would come to our school tomorrow.
imitations.zh: 他们明天会来我们学校。

patterns.pattern: If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形

original.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
original.zh: 如果她来，她会得到一个惊喜。

imitations.en: If it is sunny, we will go to the park.
imitations.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去公园。

imitations.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
imitations.zh: 如果你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + must be + 名词/形容词

original.en: It must be the only modern house in the district.
original.zh: 它一定是这个地区唯一的现代房子。

imitations.en: This must be the correct answer.

lines.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday. She lives in Nigeria.
lines.zh: 昨天我收到了姐姐的一封信，她住在尼日利亚。

lines.en: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
lines.zh: 在信中她说她明年将到英国来。

lines.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
lines.zh: 如果她来了，她会感到非常惊奇了。

lines.en: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
lines.zh: 我们现在住在乡间的一栋漂亮的新住宅里。

lines.en: Work on it had begun before my sister left. The house was completed five months ago.
lines.zh: 这栋房子在我姐姐离开之前就已动工了，是在5个月以前竣工的。

lines.en: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.
lines.zh: 我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。

lines.en: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
lines.zh: 这栋房子里有许多房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。

lines.en: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.
lines.zh: 它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，因此在有些人看来很古怪。

lines.en: It must be the only modern house in the district
lines.zh: 它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。

questions.q: Why is the new house special?
questions.zh: 这栋新房子为什么特别？
questions.a: Because it is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people, and it must be the only modern house in the district.
questions.aZh: 因为它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，有些人觉得它很古怪，而且它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。

questions.q: Why is the past perfect tense used in 'Work on it had begun before my sister left'?
questions.zh: 为什么句中用过去完成时 had begun？
questions.a: Because the building work started before another past action (my sister left); the past perfect expresses 'the past in the past'.
questions.aZh: 因为“动工”发生在“姐姐离开”这一过去动作之前，过去完成时用来表示“过去的过去”。
questions.hint: 见第五句，并与 The house was completed five months ago 对照。

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'We are now living in a beautiful new house' instead of 'We live in...'?
questions.zh: 为什么课文用现在进行时 are living，而不用一般现在时 live？
questions.a: Live usually describes a permanent state and is rarely used in the continuous form; here the -ing form with 'now' emphasises the present situation.
questions.aZh: live 表示长期居住，一般不用进行时；这里与 now 连用，用进行时强调目前的居住情况。
questions.hint: 见第四句 We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country。

questions.q: Why does the text use 'there is' in 'there is a lovely garden' rather than 'it is'?
questions.zh: 为什么用 there is a lovely garden，而不用 it is？
questions.a: 'There is' introduces the existence of something mentioned for the first time; once it has been identified, 'it' is used to say more about it.
questions.aZh: there is 用于引出“存在某物”（首次提到的花园）；已经被指明之后，才用 it 进一步说明。
questions.hint: 见第七句 The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden。

questions.q: Why will the sister get a surprise when she comes to England?
questions.zh: 为什么姐姐来英国时会感到非常惊奇？
questions.a: She left before the house was finished, so she still pictures the old home; now she will find a beautiful new modern house in the country that must be the only modern house in the district.
questions.aZh: 她是在房子动工前后离开的，印象里还是旧居；如今看到的却是乡间一栋漂亮、现代化、且是当地唯一的现代住宅，自然会大吃一惊。

translation:
昨天我收到了姐姐的一封信，她住在尼日利亚。
在信中她说她明年将到英国来。
如果她来了，她会感到非常惊奇了。
我们现在住在乡间的一栋漂亮的新住宅里。
这栋房子在我姐姐离开之前就已动工了，是在5个月以前竣工的。
我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。
这栋房子里有许多房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。
它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，因此在有些人看来很古怪。
它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。
title: A new house
subtitle: 新居

lead.question: 姐姐明年要来英国，她为什么会对我们的乡间新居感到惊奇？
lead.warmup: 一封来自尼日利亚的信，把一个家庭搬进乡间新居的故事悄悄铺开。姐姐动身前，房子就已动工；五个月后竣工，它成了当地唯一的一栋现代化住宅——漂亮，却也让一些人觉得古怪。读这篇课文时，请留意作者如何用过去完成时交代“更早发生的事”，用 there is 引出花园，并用 must be 作出肯定的推测。
goals: 掌握 complete、modern、strange、district 的词义与搭配：complete a house、a modern house、look strange to sb.、in the district
理解过去完成时 had begun 表示“过去的过去”，并与一般过去时 was completed 对照使用
分清 there is 与 it is 的分工：there be 引出存在，it 用于进一步说明已指明的事物
学会用 must be 表示肯定推测，以及 if 引导的真实条件句“主将从现”
lead.summary: 课文以姐姐的来信起笔：她明年要来英国，一来就会大吃一惊——因为作者一家已住进乡间一栋漂亮的新房子。这栋房子在姐姐离开前就已动工，五个月前竣工，里面有许多大房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。它非常现代化，因此在有些人看来很古怪，而且肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。
lead.tips: complete 是及物动词，“房子竣工”要说 The house was completed...；in the country 表“在乡下”时 the 不能丢；work on it 中的 work 是抽象不可数名词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这栋房子是 5 个月以前竣工的。
exercises.a: The house was completed five months ago.
exercises.note: complete 是及物动词，竣工须用被动。

exercises.q: 汉译英：它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。
exercises.a: It must be the only modern house in the district.
exercises.note: must 后接原形 be，地区用 in the district。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 so 合并为一句。It is a very modern house. It looks strange to some people.
exercises.a: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 if 合并为一句。She will come to England next year. She will get a surprise.
exercises.a: If she comes to England next year, she will get a surprise.
exercises.note: 真实条件句主将从现，从句用 comes。

exercises.q: 填空：用括号内动词的适当形式填空。Work on it had begun before my sister ____ (leave).
exercises.note: 姐姐离开是过去动作，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 填空：用 there is 或 it is 填空。____ a lovely garden behind the house. ____ is very lovely.
exercises.note: 先 there be 引出存在，再用 it 说明。

exercises.q: 改错：改正句中一处错误。We are now living in a beautiful new house in country.
exercises.a: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
exercises.note: country 作“乡下”讲时必须带 the。

quiz.q: 课文中“这栋房子是5个月以前竣工的”，正确的英文表达是哪一项？
options: The house was completed five months ago.
The house completed five months ago.
The house had completed five months ago.
The house was completing five months ago.
quiz.note: 房子是被建成的，须用被动 was completed。

quiz.q: Work on it had begun before my sister left. 句中的 work on 是什么意思？
options: do building work on something
finish something completely
travel to a place
live in a place
quiz.note: work on 意为“在……上施工／着手做”。

quiz.q: 课文中 in the country 的含义是哪一项？
options: in the countryside
in the nation
in the city centre
in that district
quiz.note: country 与 the 连用、与 town 相对时意为“乡下”。

quiz.q: “这房子在有些人看来很古怪”，正确的英文是哪一项？
options: The house looks strange to some people.
The house looks strangely to some people.
The house is looked strange to some people.
Some people look the house strange.
quiz.note: look 是系动词，后接形容词 strange；“对某人来说”用 to sb.。

quiz.q: “它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅”，正确的英文是哪一项？
options: It must be the only modern house in the district.
It must is the only modern house in the district.
It must be the only modern house of the district.
It must be the only modern house at the district.
quiz.note: must 后一律接动词原形 be；固定用 in the district。

quiz.q: 课文先说 There is a lovely garden，接着要进一步说明这个花园很大，句首应该用哪一项？
options: It is
There is
There has
It has
quiz.note: 用 there be 引出存在之后，须换用 it 作主语进一步说明。
